youtube.title: Plumbing Business Tips: A Quiet-Quote Text for HVAC and Roofing Owners
youtube.description:
Plumbing business tips: one quiet-quote text for HVAC, roofing and home service business owners.
ServiceTitan's own data shows only 37% of estimates close on the first visit (ServiceTitan, "Follow-Ups 101: Back 2 Basics," Apr 17, 2026).
In a Housecall Pro survey of 1,040 U.S. homeowners, 59% expect text updates ("The new home service standard," Dec 10, 2025; survey fielded Oct 23, 2025).
ServiceTitan's follow-up webinar says texting beats email on open rates.

The quiet-quote text:
1. Hi [name], it's [you].
2. Still want that water heater swapped before winter?
3. Send it as a text, with one name, one job and one yes-or-no question.

Jobber's follow-up tips: use their name, name the job and ask a question. Jobber's email follow-up timing: first within 2 days after sending the quote, next 1 week after the initial quote, final a day or two before the quote expires. After 3 follow-ups, close the file (Jobber Academy, updated May 28, 2026).
Send this to whoever follows up on your quotes.
Next lesson: more practical quote follow-up help for trade business owners.
